session_geometry_open_semantics.signal_date_open_source: accepted Open evidence on exact signal session t

price_evidence_contract.open_rule: entry Open is usable only when market_state ACTIVE, open_admitted true, and accepted_open finite positive
price_evidence_contract.close_rule: terminal Close is usable only when market_state ACTIVE, close_admitted true, and close finite positive
price_evidence_contract.generation_1_basis: raw executable price basis only; no adjusted endpoint-price layer is admitted

continuity_evidence_contract.cross_basis_event_policy: generation 1 never adjusts target endpoint prices. Any split, reverse split, stock dividend, bonus share, rights issue, or other mechanical share/price-basis event that may cross after Open_(t+1) through and including Close_(t+h) is PRICE_CONTINUITY_UNRESOLVED. A future same-basis endpoint layer requires a new preregistered generation and is not an allowed passing shortcut here.

rank_transform.population: defensibly horizon-target-observable rows inside the frozen decision universe on the same decision date
rank_transform.consensus_formula: 0.5 * target_rank_h5 + 0.5 * target_rank_h10 only when both targets are available

historical_execution_authorization.blocker: market-wide V4 forward-price continuity evidence ledger has not yet passed an outcome-blind support census under this protocol

compute IC, Top30, spread, bootstrap, or raw-return diagnostics
infer corporate-action effective date from price discontinuity
treat missing corporate-action evidence as no event
silently reinterpret corporate_action_integrity_verified as full V4 continuity proof
